# check_nic_basic

> A Nagios/Icinga plugin for basic network-interface checks.

The shell plugin checks whether a specified NIC is present in the interface list and whether it has an IPv4 address assigned.

## Repository overview

- [Source repository](https://github.com/useidel/check_nic_basic): Canonical GitHub repository, including source files, issues, history, and repository metadata.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/useidel/check_nic_basic/HEAD/README.md): Primary project documentation and usage notes.
